messages:
Mina: Quick thread — we need to finalize the NovaPulse customer story + webinar flow. Key asks: quote approvals (including translated variants), demo slot, recording consent, and lead routing split (AE for demo requests, CS for trial signups). Brief: https://redwood.docs/novapulse-brief :spiral_calendar:
Carlos: I'll coordinate interviews. Suggested spokes: CTO (infra) + Head of Product (metrics). Also want a 6-min live demo midway.
Yuna: Draft pull quote: "NovaPulse reduced inference unit cost while improving latency after migrating to Redwood Inference." Would like to produce localized versions (EN/DE/FR) — need translated quote signoff from NovaPulse.
Grace: Legal note: avoid publishing exact percentages unless NovaPulse provides signed confirmation. For translated quotes, we need the original signed approval plus translator attestation. If they request transcript redactions or an NDA for translations, expect +3 business days. Tag any percent with [LEGAL].
Sam: For routing: registration webhook -> SFDC campaign Nova-Q3-Launch. If form.request_demo==true -> assign queue nova-ae, if form.trial_interest==true -> assign queue nova-cs. Add hidden field locale for routing (locale=DE/FR/EN).
Mina: Also add consent copy with GDPR variant and a short consent for translated materials: "I consent to being contacted by Redwood, to the recording being used for marketing, and to translated excerpts being published." Yuna, can you craft the EU-friendly phrasing?
Yuna: Drafted EU copy: "I consent to Redwood contacting me and to the webinar recording and translated excerpts being used for marketing. Data processed per the privacy policy." Added to reg form when geo=EU.
Carlos: Sent quote & translated snippets to NovaPulse for redline. Asked them to confirm any percent stats by email if they want them published. Also requested translator contact for attestation.
localization-bot: registration form updated; hidden fields: locale, consent=true. Webhook test passed in staging -> SFDC campaign Nova-Q3-Launch. Mapping preview: POST -> {campaign:"Nova-Q3-Launch", owner_queue: (request_demo?"nova-ae": (trial_interest?"nova-cs":"nova-marketing")), locale}
Mina: Calendar note: embargo target Oct 7. Legal signoff needed by Oct 1. If NovaPulse approves translated quotes in email we can include percent numbers; otherwise use conservative language. Also set a 72-hour redaction window post-transcript for translations.
Grace: If NovaPulse requests translator review on verbatim quotes, that may add 48-72 hours. Will fast-track review if they flag it.
Sam: I'll implement routing rule to preserve existing lead owner and tag lead.locale from hidden locale field. Also add partner=false default. Testing in prod after legal OK.
Mina: TL;DR: interviews scheduling, translated quote workflow added + localization attestation, legal looped for percent & NDA if needed, reg consent incl EU and translation clause, SFDC routing to nova-ae/nova-cs, embargo Oct 7, 72-hour redaction window for translated transcripts. Check-in tomorrow AM. :rocket:
